title: Slow English Reading: Rainbow Fish for Beginners (A1–A2)

sentences.en: Welcome back to my slow English podcast.
sentences.tc: 歡迎回到我的慢速英語podcast。

sentences.en: The entire ocean. His scales were every shade of blue and green and purple with sparkling silver scales among them. The other fish were amazed at his beauty.
sentences.tc: 整個海洋。他的鱗片呈藍色、綠色和紫色，其中有閃閃發光的銀色鱗片。其他魚都驚訝於他的美麗。

sentences.en: They called him the rainbow fish. Come on, rainbow fish.
sentences.tc: 他們稱他為彩虹魚。來吧，彩虹魚。

sentences.en: They would call. Come and play with us. But the rainbow fish would just glide past, proud and silent, letting his scales shimmer. One day, a little blue fish followed.
sentences.tc: 他們會打電話。來和我們一起玩吧。但彩虹魚會驕傲而沉默地滑過，讓它的鱗片閃閃發光。有一天，一條藍色的小魚跟著來了。

sentences.en: He called. Wait for me. Please give me one of your shiny scales.
sentences.tc: 他打電話來。等我。請給我一片閃亮的鱗片。

sentences.en: They are so wonderful. And you have so many. You want me to give you one of my special scales?
sentences.tc: 他們太棒了。而你有這麼多。你想讓我給你一把我的特殊秤嗎？

sentences.en: Who do you think you are? Cried the rainbow fish. Get away from me. Shocked, the little blue fish swam away?
sentences.tc: 你以為你是誰？彩虹魚叫道。離我遠點。一驚，小藍魚遊走了？

sentences.en: He was so upset.
sentences.tc: 他很沮喪。

sentences.en: Then on, no one would have anything to do with Rainbow Fish.
sentences.tc: 從此以後，就沒有人再和彩虹魚有任何關係了。

sentences.en: He swam by. What good were the dazzling shimmering scales with no one to admire them? Now.
sentences.tc: 他遊過去了。那些閃閃發光的鱗片如果沒有人欣賞又有什麼用呢？現在。

sentences.en: He was the lonliest fish in the entire ocean. One day.
sentences.tc: 他是整個海洋中最孤獨的魚。一天。

sentences.en: He poured out all of his troubles to the starfish. I really am beautiful. Why doesn't anybody like me? I can't answer that for you, said the starfish.
sentences.tc: 他把所有的煩惱都傾訴給了海星。我確實很美麗。為什麼沒有人喜歡我？ 「我無法回答你這個問題，」海星說。

sentences.en: If you go beyond the coral reef to a deep cave, you will find the wise octopus. Maybe.
sentences.tc: 如果你越過珊瑚礁進入一個很深的洞穴，你會發現聰明的章魚。或許。

sentences.en: She can help you. The rainbow fish found the cave.
sentences.tc: 她可以幫助你。彩虹魚找到了洞穴。

sentences.en: It was very dark inside.
sentences.tc: 裡面很暗。

sentences.en: He couldn't see anything.
sentences.tc: 他什麼也看不見。

sentences.en: Then suddenly two eyes caught him in their glare and the octopus emerged from the darkness.
sentences.tc: 突然，兩隻眼睛注視著他，章魚從黑暗中出現了。

sentences.en: Other fish. You will no longer be the most beautiful fish in the sea.
sentences.tc: 其他魚。你將不再是大海裡最美麗的魚。

sentences.en: You will discover how to be happy. I can't, the rainbow fish started to say. But the octopus had already disappeared into a dark cloud of ink. Give away my scales. My.
sentences.tc: 你會發現如何快樂。我不能，彩虹魚開始說。但那隻章魚已經消失在一片漆黑的墨雲之中。把我的秤給我吧我的。

sentences.en: Beautiful shining scales. Never. How could I ever be happy without them? Suddenly,.
sentences.tc: 美麗閃亮的鱗片。絕不。沒有他們我怎麼能幸福呢？突然，。

sentences.en: He felt the light touch of a fin. The little blue fish was back. Rainbow fish, please don't be angry.
sentences.tc: 他感覺到鰭輕輕的觸碰。小藍魚又回來了。彩虹魚，請不要生氣。

sentences.en: I just want one little scale. The rainbow fish wavered. Only one very, small shimmery scale,.
sentences.tc: 我只想要一個小秤。彩虹魚動搖了。只有一個非常非常小的閃閃發光的鱗片。

sentences.en: He thought. Well, maybe I wouldn't miss just one. Carefully, the rainbow fish pulled out the smallest scale and gave it to the little fish.
sentences.tc: 他想。好吧，也許我不會錯過任何一個。彩虹魚小心翼翼地把最小的鱗片拔了出來，遞給了小魚。

sentences.en: Thank you. Very much. The little blue fish bubbled playfully as.
sentences.tc: 謝謝。非常。藍色的小魚頑皮地吐著泡泡。
